propositions: A deterministic shadow comparator must consume the same call/result set as legacy and RP-06 projections and report field-level mismatches against an approved delta allowlist without issuing provider calls or controlling final verdict.

Repository-policy/contract guards must fail when a review gate bypasses CriteriaSnapshot to read packaged/project routing directly, when a second discovery scheduler is introduced outside the shared kernel, or when per-unit trace fields enter review/review-status schemas.

A live provider canary must exercise both defaulted gate paths through the real external LLM provider matrix, prove at least one discovery call reaches the configured provider, and assert the final narrow verdict plus retained internal trace without printing secrets or prompt bodies.

New code must ignore legacy checkpoint envelopes; the retained compatibility projection cannot write new envelopes or decide a final verdict; rollback requires only a code revert with no journal rewrite or data cleanup.
Documentation must state final snapshot/executor/gate/RP-01 ownership, approved deltas, sensitive-data boundary, shadow behavior, and revert-based rollback strategy in docs/review-kernel.md.

The cross-gate cutover was verified live across three provider arms (anthropic, openai, bedrock) with confirmed real discovery calls reaching each provider and narrow final verdicts (PASS/BLOCK) achieved on all arms.
